Calculate stop-level departure counts, route counts, and first/last departure times.

import pandas as pd
from zipfile import ZipFile
from io import StringIO

# Load cleaned stops and stop times
stops = pd.read_csv('outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv')
stop_times = pd.read_csv('outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv')

# Load trips from GTFS zip
with ZipFile('inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip', 'r') as gtfs_zip:
    with gtfs_zip.open('trips.txt', 'r') as trips_file:
        trips = pd.read_csv(trips_file)

# Merge stop times with trips
merged = pd.merge(stop_times, trips[['route_id']], on='route_id')

# Group by stop id and calculate counts
grouped = merged.groupby('stop_id')
n_departures = grouped.size().reset_index(name='n_departures')
n_routes = grouped['route_id'].nunique().reset_index(name='n_routes')
first_departure = grouped['departure_time'].min().reset_index(name='first_departure')
last_departure = grouped['departure_time'].max().reset_index(name='last_departure')

# Merge counts and times
service_intensity = pd.merge(n_departures, n_routes, on='stop_id')
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, first_departure, on='stop_id')
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, last_departure, on='stop_id')

# Merge stop info
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, stops, on='stop_id')

# Write output
service_intensity.to_csv('outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
from zipfile import ZipFile
from io import StringIO

# Load cleaned stops and stop times
stops = pd.read_csv('outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv')

with ZipFile('inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip', 'r') as gtfs_zip:
    with gtfs_zip.open('trips.txt', 'r') as trips_file:
        trips = pd.read_csv(trips_file)

# Merge stop times with trips
merged = pd.merge(stop_times, trips[['route_id']], on='route_id')

# Group by stop id and calculate counts
grouped = merged.groupby('stop_id')
n_departures = grouped.size().reset_index(name='n_departures')
n_routes = grouped['route_id'].nunique().reset_index(name='n_routes')
first_departure = grouped['departure_time'].min().reset_index(name='first_departure')
last_departure = grouped['departure_time'].max().reset_index(name='last_departure')

# Merge counts and times
service_intensity = pd.merge(n_departures, n_routes, on='stop_id')
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, first_departure, on='stop_id')
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, last_departure, on='stop_id')

# Merge stop info
service_intensity = pd.merge(service_intensity, stops, on='stop_id')
